title: AI voice receptionist for a plumbing business
tagline: It picks up on the first ring, day or night, works out the job and how urgent it is, logs the lead, adds it to the CRM and texts the plumber the details.

title: WhatsApp support agent with a human handoff
tagline: It answers customers from the business's knowledge base, scores its own confidence, and passes refunds, complaints and anything it does not know to a person on Slack with the full context.

title: Ecommerce support agent: orders, returns and escalation
tagline: It reads each customer message, works out what they need, answers from live order data, starts returns, and sends complaints and billing disputes to a person.

title: Real estate inquiry triage and routing
tagline: It reads every inquiry, sorts it into buying, selling, renting or general, sends a personal reply, and posts serious leads to the right team's channel.

title: AI invoice extraction pipeline
tagline: Email an invoice in and it pulls out the vendor, invoice number, date, amount, tax and currency, files them in a sheet, posts a confirmation to Slack, and flags incomplete invoices for review.

title: Voice agent with a knowledge base and post-call automation
tagline: It answers in a natural voice, looks up prices, service areas and hours in a knowledge base during the call, and after the call files the lead in a sheet and CRM and alerts the team.

title: Cancellation win-back in GoHighLevel
tagline: When a subscriber cancels, it asks why, waits, makes the case for returning over the following weeks, then checks whether they resubscribed and files them as reactivated or lost.

title: Failed payment recovery in GoHighLevel
tagline: When a subscription payment fails, it emails the customer, checks whether they paid, follows up by SMS, checks again, and only then flags the account for a person.

title: AI lead capture and qualification
tagline: Every form submission is logged, answered with a personal reply written by AI, sorted as hot or cold, and hot leads ping the owner in Slack.

title: Lead capture and follow-up in GoHighLevel
tagline: When a lead fills in a form, it adds them to the pipeline, picks text and email or email only, runs a follow-up sequence over several days, and stops if they reply STOP.

title: Post-purchase subscriber lifecycle in GoHighLevel
tagline: When someone subscribes, it tags them, adds them to the pipeline, welcomes them, shows them how to use the product, sets honest expectations, checks in at 30, 60 and 90 days, then asks for a review.

title: Refill reminder in GoHighLevel
tagline: When a subscriber is due to reorder, it reminds them, checks whether they did, follows up once by SMS, and hands anyone who lapses to the win-back sequence.

title: Lead tracking and follow-ups
tagline: New leads in a Google Sheet are recorded in Notion, thanked by message through Twilio, marked as processed, and emailed through Gmail if they are still pending after three days.

title: Restaurant ordering chatbot
tagline: It keeps itself up to date from files in Google Drive and uses them to answer menu questions, help with orders and give restaurant details.

title: AI prospect calls and meeting scheduling
tagline: An AI assistant calls every prospect marked Not Called, logs the outcome in the sheet, and books a meeting for interested prospects at the time they prefer.
